# developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Docs — Guides — Data Lens

> 7 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Docs — Guides under Data Lens. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Data Lens

- [Data Lens](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/data-lens/overview/): Data Lens is a Snowflake-based cloud data sharing product that provides merchants with direct SQL access to their payments data.
- [Getting Started](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/data-lens/getting-started/): This section walks through how to activate Data Lens, connect to your Snowflake account, and verify access by running your first query.
- [Data Schema Reference](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/data-lens/data-schema-reference/): Data Lens organizes data into five interconnected schemas designed for financial operations, reconciliation, and analytics.
- [Integration Patterns](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/data-lens/integration-patterns/): Choose the integration pattern that best fits your use case:
- [Best Practices and Security](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/data-lens/best-practices/): This section covers security controls built into Data Lens and recommended practices for writing efficient queries.
- [Troubleshooting](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/data-lens/troubleshooting/): This section covers common errors you may encounter when connecting to or querying Data Lens, along with their likely causes and recommended solutions.
- [Support and Resources](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/data-lens/support/): This section lists the available support channels and reference documentation for Data Lens.
